changes: While more than 8 messages wait for the UI task (an overloaded unit or a held-up UI), every other frame step is left out at the frame step's call (0x400a4a32), so waiting keys, pads and notes are taken sooner; the adaptive screen rate of the author's private bases, moved into the module. Engine code unchanged from 0.1.0.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
